declarations.type:
∀ {initial : SearchRouteInspectLoop.InspectLoopState} {graph : SearchRouteDAG.RankedDAG}
  {source target : Fin graph.nodeCount} {requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement}
  {budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget}
  {catalog : List (SearchRouteInspectTraceCatalog.RealizedTraceCatalogEntry initial graph source target)}
  {selected : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate},
  SearchRouteInspectTraceCatalog.RealizedTraceCatalogComplete graph source target requirement budget catalog →
    SearchRouteDAG.chooseBestGraphCandidate requirement budget
          (SearchRouteInspectTraceCatalog.projectTraceCatalog catalog) =
        some selected →
      (∃ entry, entry ∈ catalog ∧ entry.candidate = selected) ∧
        SearchRouteDAG.Realizes graph source target selected ∧
          ∀ (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
            SearchRouteDAG.Realizes graph source target candidate →
              SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB requirement budget candidate = true →
                SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse selected candidate
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectTraceCatalog.complete_trace_catalog_selects_global_driver

declarations.type:
SearchRouteDAG.chooseBestGraphCandidate SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget
      [SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph] =
    some SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph ∧
  SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB SearchRouteCost.nonGraphRequirement SearchRouteDAG.generousGraphBudget
        SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph =
      true ∧
    ¬SearchRouteDAG.graphLexNoWorse SearchRouteDAG.shortInteractionLongGraph SearchRouteDAG.longInteractionShortGraph
declarations.name: SearchRouteInspectTraceCatalog.incomplete_catalog_can_hide_cheaper_driver
